lines: The Crawling Chaos remembers.
Turn 1, as you arrived on a level: whisper 1 (ambient) was admitted.
Telegraph: "A distant whisper brushes against your thoughts."
Effect: an omen only; no rule changed.
Delivered: yes, "The shadows lean closer." was shown with the telegraph.
Spent at once.
Turn 10, after you doubled back: a haunting was admitted.
Telegraph: "Something has learned the rhythm of your footsteps."
Effect: an echo hound was set to follow your trail.
Delivered: yes, you saw it follow your trail 1 time.
Ended: it was killed on turn 13.
Motif: the whistle, 1 program, felt 1 time.
Turn 385: next-use program 1 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL2 on turn 385.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 5).
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may ring on after you stop."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: yes, 2 times; the note rang on in your head and confused you.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 1065, as you prayed: whisper 2 (door_reluctance) was admitted.
Telegraph: "The doors of this place seem to lean against you."
Effect: closed doors resisted you more often, for 192 turns.
Delivered: no; a rule change has no separate manifestation.
Ended: expired on turn 1257.
Admitted 4, delivered 3; cruelty spent 4.
1 other candidate was refused; none took effect.
